Sunder.Name: Sunder
Sunder.Description: Condition. Damage dealt to this character can't be reduced, ignoring effects like Damage Reduction.

Exhaustion.Name: Exhaustion
Exhaustion.Description: Condition. On their turn, can only take one Half Action and can't take Full Actions. Movement is not affected.

Stagger.Name: Stagger
Stagger.Description: Condition. Can only make one attack per turn and can't take Interrupts.

Blind.Name: Blind
Blind.Description: Condition. Can't see. Misses all attacks and can only target adjacent squares with abilities.

Immobilized.Name: Immobilized
Immobilized.Description: Condition. Can't move, including the standard move and Sprint.

Impairment.Name: Impairment
Impairment.Description: Condition. Deals half damage and provides halved Stamina recovery to themself and others.

Hemorrhage.Name: Hemorrhage
Hemorrhage.Description: Condition. Each Full Action, Fast Action or Interrupt (or each attack made as part of one) deals 1/10 of maximum Stamina (rounded down, minimum 1) as Piercing Nature damage, bypassing Barrier.

Invisible.Name: Invisible
Invisible.Description: Condition. Can't be targeted by characters who can't perceive Invisible creatures. Has Advantage on all attacks. Lost after taking an action that affects another character, unless otherwise specified.

Burn.Name: Burn
Burn.Description: Condition. At the start of each turn, take Piercing Fire damage equal to twice the points of Burn. Fortitude Save at the end of each turn: lose 1 point per Hit.

Electrocution.Name: Electrocution
Electrocution.Description: Condition. Can't take Interrupts. At the start of each turn, take Piercing Shock damage equal to the points of Electrocution. Fortitude Save at the end of each turn: lose 1 point per Hit.

Toxic.Name: Toxic
Toxic.Description: Condition. Can't make Attacks. At the start of each turn, take Piercing Nature damage equal to the points of Toxic. Fortitude Save at the end of each turn: lose 1 point per Hit.

Agony.Name: Agony
Agony.Description: Condition. Can't use Talents. At the start of each turn, take Piercing Psychic damage equal to the points of Agony. Fortitude Save at the end of each turn: lose 1 point per Hit.

Stun.Name: Stun
Stun.Description: Condition. Unable to act. Resistance is 0 until the Stun ends.

Haste.Name: Haste
Haste.Description: Condition. Can take any Half Action as a Free Action 1/Turn. When Haste ends, Exhausted until the end of their next turn.

Berserk.Name: Berserk
Berserk.Description: Condition. Must move as close to the nearest character as possible and use all actions to Attack the nearest character; can't take any other actions. May make a Fast Attack as a Free Action once per turn, and must if able. When Berserk ends, Exhausted until the end of their next turn.

Slow.Name: Slow
Slow.Description: Condition. Doesn't receive their Standard Movement on their turn.

Terror.Name: Terror
Terror.Description: Condition. Can't willingly move closer to the source of their fear, and must use their Standard Movement to run from it at the start of their turn. Can't target the source with Actions or respond to it with Interrupts.

Mangle.Name: Mangle
Mangle.Description: Condition. Can't regain Stamina by any means except Knockout Rolls.

Concussion.Name: Concussion
Concussion.Description: Status Effect. Becomes Incapacitated the next time they would make a Knockout Roll. Cured when the character begins a Rest or Downtime.

Exposed.Name: Exposed
Exposed.Description: Status Effect. Vulnerable to Attacks of Opportunity. Cured with the Patch action and some Trait or Vow abilities.

Grappled.Name: Grappled
Grappled.Description: Status Effect. Grappled or snared by another character: movement and attacks are restricted, and harder to hit with Ranged attacks. See the Grapple action.

Prone.Name: Prone
Prone.Description: Status Effect. Ranged attacks against them have Disadvantage; Melee attacks against them have Advantage. Each space moved costs 2. Dropping Prone is a Free Action; standing up takes the Standard Movement or a Half Action.

Ironheart.Name: Ironheart
Ironheart.Description: Stance. In Ironheart Stance, Armor Rating grants Damage Reduction (All) equal to the full Armor Rating.

VowFeature.Name: Vow Feature
VowFeature.Description: A vow feature's effect is active. See the feature for what it does.

HostileEffect1.Name: Hostile Effect 1
HostileEffect1.Description: Status Effect. A monster's effect is active. Monster effects are Status Effects unless they say they're Conditions.

HostileEffect2.Name: Hostile Effect 2
HostileEffect2.Description: Status Effect. A monster's effect is active. Monster effects are Status Effects unless they say they're Conditions.

HostileEffect3.Name: Hostile Effect 3
HostileEffect3.Description: Status Effect. A monster's effect is active. Monster effects are Status Effects unless they say they're Conditions.

HostileEffect4.Name: Hostile Effect 4
HostileEffect4.Description: Status Effect. A monster's effect is active. Monster effects are Status Effects unless they say they're Conditions.

Incapacitated.Name: Incapacitated
Incapacitated.Description: Status Effect. Knocked out by their injuries and unable to act.

Dead.Name: Dead
Dead.Description: Status Effect. Killed by their Wounds.

DamageReduction.Title: Damage Reduction
DamageReduction.All: All except Psychic, Holy and Unholy
DamageReduction.AllButPhysical: All except Physical, Psychic, Holy and Unholy

Effect.spiked: Spiked: when an attack lands on the wearer, the attacker is Mangled until the end of the turn. Critical Attacks bypass this.
Effect.belted: Belted: the wearer can have an additional Hunter's Tool ready for use.
Effect.plated: Plated: Damage Reduction (Physical) from Armor Rating equals the full Armor Rating.
Effect.articulated: Articulated: no Evasion penalty; armor with no Evasion penalty gives +1 Evasion instead.
Effect.engraved: Engraved: has a Spinel or Jade Slot.

Armor.MediumMasteryEffect: Medium Armor Mastery: +1 Armor Rating and no Speed penalty.

Notes.OffHandFastAttack: Off-Hand: no Attack Attribute Damage if this was the off-hand attack of a Fast Attack.
Notes.Precise: Precise: deals an extra 1d6 Physical damage on a critical attack.
Notes.Focus: Focus: normal attacks are Improvised and deal 1 Physical damage.
Notes.Broken: This weapon is Broken and provides no benefits.
Notes.PreciseApplied: Precise: +1d6 Physical damage for the critical attack.
Notes.BulkyAdjacent: Bulky: an enemy is adjacent, so this attack has Disadvantage.
Notes.BulkyUnknown: Bulky: Disadvantage if any enemy is adjacent. There's no token on the scene to check.

Weapon.CannotRollDamage: You don't own that weapon, so you can't roll its damage.

Problem.goldLimit: Only one Gold ornament can be active

Combat.Acted: Has used all activations this round
Combat.ActedUndo: Has used all activations this round. Click to undo the last one.

Check.Title: {label} Check
Check.NoDice: No dice to roll: automatic failure.

FleshWound.Title: Flesh Wound
FleshWound.Text: The attack leaves only a flesh wound, and {name} recovers Stamina with no further penalty.
FleshWound.Quote: Fight on, {name}. Death hasn't come yet.

ImpairingWound.Title: Impairing Wound
ImpairingWound.Text: {name} suffers an impairment, and rolls to determine the nature of the injury.
ImpairingWound.Quote: The claws of Sin dig deeper into you, {name}.

Concussion.Title: Concussion
Concussion.Quote: It's getting close now, {name}. Stay standing, if you still can.

Knockout.Title: Knockout
Knockout.Text: {name} succumbs to their Wounds and is Incapacitated.

DeepWound.Title: Deep Wound
DeepWound.Text: One Wound becomes a Grievous Wound.

VitalBlow.Title: Vital Blow
VitalBlow.Text: {name} is Exhausted until the end of their next turn.

Daze.Title: Daze
Daze.Text: {name} is Impaired until the end of their next turn.

Feature.DicePlaceholder: Blank for none. Dice for a check (3, @power + 1) or a formula (4d6, 3d6 + @power)
Feature.BadDice: {name}: "{formula}" isn't a roll Foundry can make. Use a number of dice for a check, such as 3 or @power + 1, or a formula such as 4d6 or 3d6 + @power.
